targets.summary: The script installs the CUDA toolkit without installing the CUDA driver first; the driver should probably be installed before the toolkit.
targets.evidence: Before: line 5 `if not "%CUDA_VERSION%" == "cpu" if not "%CUDA_VERSION%" == "xpu" call internal\cuda_install.bat`, then line 8 called driver_update.bat. Merged: line 5 is now `if not "%CUDA_VERSION%" == "cpu" if not "%CUDA_VERSION%" == "xpu" call internal\driver_update.bat`, and `call internal\cuda_install.bat` comes after it. So the driver now gets installed before the CUDA toolkit, which is what the maintainer asked for. One unrelated side change: the cpu/xpu guard was dropped from the cuda_install call.
